reason: I've never bought magnesium and Boots has it for about £5, so paying nearly four times that upfront for a brand with no reviews, shipping in January, is a gamble I won't take with everything else I'm juggling.
objection: I'd be paying now for something that might not arrive until mid-January, from a brand I've never heard of, with no one to tell me whether it works.
would_change_my_mind: A handful of real reviews from women my age saying it helped their tiredness, plus a firm delivery date I could rely on.
